scope: Pure first-job succeeded-RTC ZIP descriptor screen before any controlled product intake. It validates the exact source/job/product name, size and restricted HTTPS URL shape, and returns a URL-free public summary. It performs no network transfer or filesystem write.

tests.first_test_failure: An http URL was already rejected by the existing job-status guard before reaching the new URL guard. The test was corrected to assert fail-closed behavior; production code and accepted URL rules were unchanged.

next_action: Do not instantiate a controlled intake asset or transfer worker against a fabricated URL. After an exact successful first job, bind the live provider descriptor and retention to an intake contract, preflight custody/space/collisions, implement and test no-replace streaming transfer, and only then acquire exact bytes under the existing conditional owner envelope.
claim_boundary: A passing generated descriptor test is not evidence that ASF produced a ZIP or that the eventual package matches these assumptions. Unknown provider URL shape must stop and be assessed rather than be substituted.
